newsitem.title: USA: Factory Card sees Q4 shr $0.22 to $0.25.
newsitem.headline: Factory Card sees Q4 shr $0.22 to $0.25.

text.p: Factory Card Outlet Corp said on Wednesday that it expects its fourth quarter earnings to be in the range of $0.22 to $0.25 a share, which is below Wall Street consensus expectations of $0.34 a share.
In the fourth quarter ending June 28, 1997, Factory Card said it expects sales to range from $39 million to $40 million, compared with $31 million in last year's fourth quarter.
The retailer of party supplies and greeting cards had its initial public offering in early December.

Factory Card said that it expects its fiscal year earnings to be in the range of $0.18 to $0.22 a share, compared with estimates of $0.33. In the prior fiscal year, the company reported earnings of $0.01 a share.
Gross margin percent and its selling, general and administrative expenses are estimated to be on plan for the quarter, Factory Card said.

The company said its fourth quarter results were hurt by some stores opening later than planned, some merchandise issues and an attempt to spur earlier Mother's Day business by mailing advertising a week earlier than it had last year.
